scripts.dev: npm run native:build:mac && cross-env MODE=dev vite build --watch
scripts.build: npm run native:build:mac && cross-env MODE=build vite build
scripts.native:build:mac: cmake -B native/SiliconedBridge/build -S native/SiliconedBridge -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native/SiliconedBridge/build --config Release
scripts.ccx: npm run native:build:mac && cross-env MODE=package vite build
scripts.zip: npm run native:build:mac && cross-env MODE=zip vite build
